story: The humble brilliance of Italy's moka coffee pot (2018)
text: There's also a fantastic Youtube video in a neutron beam facility of a Moka pot, in which you can see the full process of brewing. The water and plastic handle appear 'black' as hydrogen scatters neutrons so strongly. [VIDEO]
